## Authentication and test credentials
The docs mention CRUD and auth examples, but they do not document any login endpoint, token format, test user, or credential source.

No auth header name or multi-tenancy header is documented in the repository docs provided.

## Deployment/runtime expectations
For a remote server, the documented sequence is `npm ci && npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/api/main.js`.

The docs do not describe any alternate test harness startup, mock server, or self-seeding behavior.

## Endpoint-test harness notes
Kerno integration tests are created from the extension in a Python file that contains an endpoint.

Use the Kerno extension, identify the endpoint, then press `Run tests with kerno` above the endpoint definition line.

The docs say Kerno starts indexing the codebase after you write the Kerno key to wake it up.

## Seeded data
Populate the database with `npx prisma db seed`.

The docs do not describe any fixture names, seeded users, or test-specific seed conventions.

## Startup and environment
Set `DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_SECRET`, and `NODE_ENV=production` in a root `.env` file for local runs.

Install dependencies with `npm install`.

Generate the Prisma client with `npx prisma generate`.

Apply migrations with `npx prisma migrate deploy`.

Start the API with `npx nx serve api`.
